in_hebrew.name: Gollin
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gollin הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'golle', meaning 'circle'. In Greek mythology, a golem is a mythical creature shaped from clay and brought to life by a rabbi. In Christianity, Gollin can represent a strong warrior of faith, protecting and defending those around them.
